svg.title: Babul carries the traced medicine crate safely into Rook Clinic.
svg.desc: Babul lifts the secured crate level with both hands and carries it through the open clinic grille. Ananya holds a direct route to the treatment bench while the balanced cycle van remains outside.
svg.text: Page 27, panel 3 · Dynamic medium shot through the clinic grille

text.tspan: Babul brings the located shipment straight to Ananya
before it can be misdirected again.
